title: Missing Rust/Python counterpart for C relayed-own-source drop on the non-RH3 forward path
description: Security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-xyix: C drops relayed datagrams claiming the node's own IPv6 source (router.c:497-502). Rust forward branch (rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:267-291) and Python forward branch (python/src/lichen/node.py) check only next-hop relations. Add the own-source drop to both forward paths with unit tests.
